dish: classic figure-eight Philly soft pretzels, warm off the trays
w: Family-run since 1981 — bakes thousands of pretzels a day on Washington Avenue by the Italian Market; reopened after a devastating fire and took Philly Mag's 2024 Best of Philly soft pretzel.

dish: fried shrimp, East Coast oysters, raw bar
w: Frankford Avenue restaurant reborn as a seafood house with a well-sourced raw bar.

dish: cheesesteak, hand-cut fries, milkshakes and egg creams
w: Around since the 1940s (the old Chink's) — retro soda-fountain cheesesteaks; Craig LaBan rated the original among his 2002 favourites. The Torresdale Ave original closed Labor Day 2022 after 73 years (Inquirer, PhillyVoice); the Fishtown shop at Girard & Front is now the flagship.

dish: gnocchi and tagliolini in the back room
w: An Irish corner bar with a half-secret back dining room where Italian chef Francesco Bellastelli cooks cash-only handmade pasta.
